description: This file defines classes and functions for segmentation model components, including convolutional heads, attention modules, loss functions, and post-processing for segmentation and panoptic outputs in an object detection framework.

classes.name: DETRsegm
classes.description: Segmentation head class integrating with a DETR model for mask prediction.

classes.name: MaskHeadSmallConv
classes.description: Convolutional head for mask prediction with upsampling and group normalization.

classes.name: MHAttentionMap
classes.description: 2D multi-head attention module returning attention weights.

classes.name: PostProcessSegm
classes.description: Post-processing for segmentation masks, resizing and thresholding.

classes.name: PostProcessPanoptic
classes.description: Converts model outputs into panoptic segmentation format, including mask merging and image generation.

methods.name: _expand
methods.description: Utility to expand a tensor along a new dimension and flatten.

methods.name: dice_loss
methods.description: Computes the DICE loss for mask similarity.

methods.name: sigmoid_focal_loss
methods.description: Computes the focal loss used in dense detection models like RetinaNet.
